title: SS28 Men's Category Opportunities
summary: Projected growth for SS28 menswear: technical tailoring, linen suits, knit polos, evening shirts.
research_period: SS28 previews published November 2025 to November 2026; SS27 runway record

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. SS28 fabric fairs open with Première Vision Paris on 26-28 January 2027, and the shows run from June to October 2027. This report projects from the first SS28 forecaster and fair previews, the SS27 runways and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it after the fairs and again after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Performance, everyday and occasion wear merge: "technical blazers, adaptable skirts, and tailored baselayers", in sun-warmed neutrals and soft gradients<sup>[1]</sup>
- Future Snoops' SS28 colour shift "After Dusk": "Deep aubergines, inky blues and murky greens are bringing a darker, more atmospheric mood to warm-weather dressing"<sup>[2]</sup>
- SS27 was shaped by heat: Hypebeast called the sun "the true main character of SS27"<sup>[3]</sup>
- C2 Fashion Studio calls SS28 "Structured Clarity": consumers "are no longer asking for more. They're asking for better"<sup>[4]</sup>

sections.heading: Opportunities
sections.body:
1. Technical tailoring.
2. Linen suits.
3. Knit and crochet polos.
4. Satin evening shirts.
5. Tailored shorts.

sections.heading: Reduce
sections.body: Styles that did not sell through in the previous comparable season.

design_implications: - Shift development time to the opportunities.
